children: John Marshall Bancorp signed a definitive stock-for-stock merger agreement with Eagle Financial to create a larger regional banking platform. Eagle shareholders will receive 2.00 shares of John Marshall Bancorp common stock per Eagle share, and Bank of Clarke will merge into John Marshall Bank at the same time. The boards of both companies unanimously approved the transaction, which is subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals, Nasdaq listing of new shares, and customary conditions. To support the deal, both companies also executed voting agreements with their directors and certain executive officers.
